relations.subject: John Garrard Burton-Page
relations.evidence: Music studies (horn) at Royal College of Music were interrupted after one term through war service in India and Burma

relations.subject: John Garrard Burton-Page
relations.evidence: after war studied from 1946 Sanskrit at Oxford (Wadham College). B.A. 1950 and M.A. 1953 Oxford.

relations.subject: John Garrard Burton-Page
relations.evidence: From 1950 taught Nepali, Hindi, from 1966 also art and archaeology at S.O.A.S. as Lecturer, then 1971 Reader.

relations.subject: John Garrard Burton-Page
relations.evidence: then 1971 Reader. In 1958-59 one year further studies at Deccan College, then several further trips to India. Retired 1982

relations.evidence: In 1958-59 one year further studies at Deccan College
